DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Baby Care"}, 'SUJI_ORDERS'[PRODUCT_CATEGORY])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({2026}, 'SUJI_ORDERS'[ORDER_YEAR])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"UPI"}, 'SUJI_ORDERS'[PAYMENT_MODE])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		CALCULATETABLE(
			VALUES('SUJI_ORDERS'[CITY]),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable2),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable3)
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0Core, 'SUJI_ORDERS'[CITY], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'SUJI_ORDERS'[CITY]
